_comment: Copy this into your project as .claude/dado-protected-terms.json and fill it in.
Nothing reads it automatically: it is a written agreement the content skills read
when you point them at it, so a review argues with your list rather than guessing.
Every value below is a placeholder in angle brackets. Replace all of them.
This file must contain public, publishable strings only - never credentials,
never private personal data, never anything the owner has not agreed to publish.

protected._comment: Must appear byte-for-byte identical. Never translated, reordered, abbreviated or expanded.
factualStrings: <An approved sentence that must survive edits word for word>

contact._comment: Public contact details only, exactly as approved for publication.

_comment: Wording that was removed deliberately and must never reappear:
previous employers, superseded titles, retired product names, wrong locations,
withdrawn claims. Zero matches is the only acceptable result.
These stay true for every project. They are restated here so the file is
self-contained when it is copied into a repository.
claimPolicy.whenEvidenceIsMissing: leave it out, use conservative wording, or flag it for user confirmation - never fill the gap with a plausible value

surfaces._comment: Every place the same facts appear. Anything missing here is what stays wrong.
